hints.title: Two Alternation Configurations
hints.text: The top row (row 1) can either be red or blue, defining two deterministic color patterns.

hints.title: Row Ball Consumption
hints.text: At row h, exactly h balls of the current row color are needed.

hints.title: Maximum Tier
hints.text: Simulate row by row until available balls of either color are exhausted. The answer is the maximum height between starting with red versus starting with blue.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sum of first h integers equals h*(h+1)/2.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; simulation terminates in O(sqrt(R + B)) steps (<= 20 steps for <= 100 balls).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Evaluate both color alternation starting orientations.
